title: Theme Controller: Theme Controller using a checkbox (daisyUI)
notes:
If a checked checkbox input or a checked radio input with theme-controller class exists in the page, The page will have the same theme as that input's value.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/theme-controller/+page.md
